title: Why One Fungus Is Still Wiping Out Frogs
hook: The fungus that caused the worst amphibian extinction in history never actually stopped spreading.
closing: Extinction wasn't the end of this fungus. Species are still losing ground to it today.
question: Which frog would you protect?

segments.say: The fungus has affected 501 amphibian species, the largest disease-driven extinction event on record.
Thirty-nine percent of those affected species are still declining today, long after the fungus was identified.
It has now hit 40 Australian frog species, proof the crisis keeps spreading to new ground.
